newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market firms on foreign interest.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market firms on foreign interest.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed its Tuesday session on an optimistic note amid strong foreign interest in the cement, oil and steel sectors, operators said.
They forecast a rally throughout the week, with investors focusing mainly on steel mill Sidex after rumours in the market that the company secured foreign funds for development projects.
The uptrend in prices would also draw support from growing demand for cement makers and oil refineries.
On Tuesday, gainers led losers 121 to 102, with 304 flat.
The independent index VAB-RA, computed by Vanguard securities, grew by 1.6 percent to 3,694.9 points, while the BIG-OTC, compiled by the BIG brokerage house, rose by 2.22 percent to 2,706.59.

Another independent index CAS-RQ, launched by Creditanstalt Securities for the first time on Tuesday, was up 2.45 percent to 617 points. All three indices are based on average prices and market capitalisation.
The rise was mainly a result of the higher share quotes for Sidex, which has around 15 percent of market capitalisation, traders said.
Cement maker Romcim was a favorite target for foreign buyers. It firmed 2,000 lei to 75,000.
Oil refineries were also at centre-stage. Petromidia ended 2,000 lei higher at 21,500 and Arpechim gained 1,200 lei to close at 25,500.
Overall, turnover inched up to 9.2 billion lei from 9.1 billion on Monday.
The VAB-RA index is displayed on VANGUARD. The CAS-RQ will be on CASE02. ($=7,232 lei)
